major: **Removed Freedeck App / Launcher, it's now one standalone installer with autoupdates**
**App Volume is going away for a second, and will be back next update!**
**Plugin loading is now faster!** Each plugin is loaded simultaneously and asynchronously!
**JS types are now available in src/types.js**
**Fixed setting plugin settings not properly allowing strings or blank forced values**
Companion now handles closing server too
Animations are now more efficient and disrupt the layout less
Plugin metadata is now immutable past the package.json (frozen, removed setName, etc.)
Closing Companion now forces Server to close
The init script is now much shorter
other: Abuse, Notifications, and Telemetry gain their own handlers
Shortened plugins' initial random ID from app.freedeck.pdx{ID} to fd.pdx{ID}
known: Overlay and Companion may clash for the single instance lock, allowing only one or the other
